objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, translated, revised, invalidated, or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to the document; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts, updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which extended validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a new document and used to define templates, validity period, and archive duration.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable for creation of new document objects for a document type.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached in the system to create a new document or added to a document.

objs.name: document_property
objs.description: Properties dialog or property data where standardized and customer-specific metadata and document control are maintained.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorization through user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute where the document author is maintained.

attributes.name: co_authors
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute where reviewers are maintained.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute where releasers are maintained.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute for translation-related participant assignment.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification on next version release.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect workflow task distribution on next version release.

objs.name: metadata_category
objs.description: Category grouping attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: office_document
objs.description: Document generated based on standard MS Office formats or opened in a local Office component for content editing.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted format displayed on the web after document save.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary object added to a document, released and published directly via switches in properties and not subject to the main document release cycle.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Relevant Equippment used to describe documents in more detail and reactivated with a document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person or system user participating in roles, workflows, distribution, acknowledgements, translation, or administration.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned for authorizations, readers, authors, reviewers, releasers, distribution, archive access, or business administration.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Registered author who receives read and write permissions and signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional personal change rights who can start the release process but has no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User who can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Participant who checks content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Participant responsible for the document and content who decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Participant who can translate released content into another language but cannot create new objects independently.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Person who creates a document or request and may be initiator or workflow participant.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for an existing document without affecting content or version history and managed in the Change proposals folder.

objs.name: release_workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported approval process for document release consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users involved in workflow, change proposals, validity extension, distribution, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: signature_documentation
objs.description: System documentation of signatures for each released version, printable as document content.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate or override a selected document and processed automatically by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for re-validating invalidated documents and selecting the corresponding document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to distribution, e-mail notification, acknowledgement, authorization, and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific or reader dashboard filled from distribution groups and showing relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search for documents, instructions, workflow status, validity, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: referenced_document
objs.description: Document referenced from another document or shown as a document-dependent detail.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated language-dependent version of a released document.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications that can be linked with documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more defined document templates when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and document control in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain metadata grouped in categories for a document.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Make changes to released document content or properties, resulting in a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_user_group
evts.description: Assign users to system role user groups or reader groups.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Enter or confirm the author in the document author field.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights through the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers in the document attributes.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers in the document attributes.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional info to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next main document version.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation and maintenance.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release to finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Inform users by e-mail about workflow status, tasks, change proposals, validity extension, distribution, or acknowledgement.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signatures
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a valid and released document is revised.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the Valid until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request, and update the Valid until date.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version and update a document that needs revision.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing the request for AKS.

evts.name: check_aks_request
evts.description: Check the AKS request and document.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Review and approve the AKS by reviewers and releasers.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document Out of force, retain the request, delete existing edited versions, and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation and create a new version of the document.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivate Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: release_reactivated_document
evts.description: Release the reactivated document according to the defined release process.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons in the distribution list for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement through workflow support without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgements_complete
evts.description: Notify the author team when all persons maintained in distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards from distribution groups in the distribution list.

evts.name: display_document_list
evts.description: List all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_detail
evts.description: Display detailed information such as Attachments, additional information, referenced documents and language versions.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: display_language_version
evts.description: Show the released language version to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to make a local addition.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.
